output.explanation: The warehouse has no web traffic or visitor data. The listed tables (dim_customers, dim_products, dim_sales_reps, fct_order_lines, fct_orders, fct_payments) only cover customers, products, sales reps, orders, and payments. Visitor counts would need a web analytics source, such as session or pageview data, which isn't in this warehouse. The closest available figure is the number of customers who placed orders in 2025, which is not the same thing as visitors, so I haven't substituted it.
